query: Assess sanctions exposure for Q2 vessel calls at Onne

executive.text: Two of 147 Q2 vessel calls at Onne involved entities with indirect exposure to OFAC-designated persons. Neither vessel is itself sanctioned, and neither call independently triggers enforcement.

criticalFindings.title: IMO 9412778 charterer shares director with OFAC SDN entry #26011
IMO 9527884 flag change 3 days before Onne arrival

evidence.title: OFAC SDN list entry #26011 (Sokolov, Andrei)
evidence.summary: Designated under EO 13662; ownership > 50% presumption applies.

evidence.title: Cross-directorship between charterer and SDN entity
evidence.summary: Same natural person listed as director in both filings.

evidence.title: Flag hopping pattern within 30 days of port call
Broker chat mentions 'discreet routing' for the voyage

analytical.text: Circumstantial link is credible but does not meet the enforcement threshold. Recommend enhanced due-diligence flag with mandatory secondary review at next call.

counterHypotheses: Namesake collision — two different Andrei Sokolovs share the identifier.
Historical directorship expired before the designation.
intelligenceGaps: Passport / national ID confirming the two Sokolov records are the same person.
Beneficial-ownership share percentage above OFAC 50% presumption.

officerActions.label: Flag IMO 9412778 for enhanced due diligence
Trigger secondary review at next port call
